titulo: The envelope on the table, four days
caption:
The envelope on the table, four days

The envelope sat on the table for four days. Opening it took ten seconds and it was fine.

Putting it off usually costs more than the thing itself, and the weight lifts the moment it is open.

For whoever finally opens the envelope.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a table and a closed envelope standing on it at the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left trembles with narrowed eyes, then its eyes go wide and it walks to the envelope. The flap lifts, a sheet slides up with a green check mark on it, and its eyes turn happy with a pulse.
